Laravel library `pepperfm/api-responder-for-laravel`, branch `3.x`; standardized API JSON via DI/Facade. Classes use `Pepperfm\ApiBaseResponder` in `src/`.

Commands:
vendor/bin/pest --filter="test name"
vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/ApiBaseResponderTest.php
composer lint-hard

Every PHP file requires `declare(strict_types=1)` (Pint-enforced). Pint preset/custom rules: `pint.json`; class/function braces next line, control braces same line; `fn()` spacing; import order unrestricted; `not_operator_with_successor_space`: false (`!$var`); prefer native types (`phpdoc_to_property_type`, `phpdoc_to_return_type`).
